newsitem.title: UK: Vickers plans chairman, top board changes.
newsitem.headline: Vickers plans chairman, top board changes.

text.p: British automotive engineering and defence group Vickers Plc said in its interim results statement on Thursday its chief executive Sir Colin Chandler will become first deputy chairman, as of today, and then chairman in Spring, next year.
Meanwhile, director Chris Woodwark, at present chief executive of Rolls-Royce Motor Cars and chairman of Cosworth, will become chief operating officer of Vickers next April.
In his statement, outgoing chairman Sir Richard Lloyd said he intended to retire at next April's AGM, with Chandler due to retain "his position as chief executive for about 12 months".
Separately, Vickers said Roger Head, its chief financial officer, has requested to step down from the board at the end of December, after 10 years at his post.
"In order to ensure an orderly handover to his successor, when recruited, Head has agreed to make himself available in 1997 in an advisory capacity, until the end of June," the company added.
Vickers did not spell out clearly what it had in mind for Chandler's succession once he ceases to be chief executive.
